verdict.title: tidepool swap aggregator
verdict.headline: Tidepool is a working swap aggregator: the sandbox wallet connected, quoted and got a clean swap transaction. The fee it charges is six times what the site advertises.
verdict.call: Swap works end to end in the sandbox; the routing fee is 0.6%, not the 0.1% the site claims.
verdict.eli5: You paste a coin, it finds the best price across a few pools and builds the swap for you. That part really works. It just keeps a bigger cut than it says.
verdict.summary: The site opened, the sandbox wallet connected through the normal wallet picker, and a 0.05 SOL swap into $TIDE produced one transaction. Dry-run on mainnet it moves exactly what the quote shows, plus a 0.0003 SOL fee to the project wallet: 0.6% of the trade, against 0.1% on the landing page. No approvals, no delegate rights, nothing that outlives the transaction. The router program is verified and the repo matches what is deployed.
verdict.watch: Watch whether the fee line on the site gets corrected, and whether the fee wallet keeps routing into the buyback it promises.
